title: It was delivered in very good condition.
text:
It was delivered in very good condition.. First, it was a beautiful table. 2nd, there's no way this item weighs only 60-something lbs. Not even the table-top by itself. The delivery guys refused to deliver the box up a single flight of stairs to my 'man-cave'. Or even help me haul it up the stairs. They cited safety concerns. So I did it myself. I'm a big strong guy too. Unfortunately I fell with it, taking a big gash out of my front door and the table, probably destroying most of the table's re-sale value.

Did Amazon and the delivery company do anything wrong? - No. Did they go the 'extra-mile' - That's a no too. And now I have a fairly decorative table with very little value anymore.

My advice: Caveat emptor. My 2nd piece of advice: Pay for the installation. You'll probably be a lot happier than I am right now.
